questions.prompt: A book club has 9 active members. The discussion coordinator needs to select a reading committee consisting of 3 members.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different reading committees of 3 members that can be chosen from the 9 members.

questions.prompt: A school quiz squad requires 2 senior students and 3 junior students. There are 7 senior students and 6 junior students available.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different quiz squads that can be formed.

questions.prompt: Ten community volunteers are to be divided into two groups, one group of 6 volunteers and one group of 4 volunteers, to work in two different community centres.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different ways these 10 volunteers can be divided into a group of 6 and a group of 4.

questions.prompt: A committee of 5 people is to be chosen from a pool of 11 candidates. One specific candidate, Daniel, must be included on the committee.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different committees that can be selected.

questions.prompt: A delegation of 4 representatives is to be chosen from a council of 12 members. One specific member, Marcus, refuses to serve and cannot be chosen.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different delegations of 4 representatives that can be chosen.

questions.prompt: Six tennis players are to be divided into three unlabelled pairs to play practice matches.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different ways these 6 players can be divided into three unlabelled pairs.

questions.prompt: A sports club has 8 badminton players and 6 squash players. A team of 5 players is to be chosen.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the total number of different teams of 5 players that can be chosen from the 14 players if there are no restrictions on player sports.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of different teams that can be chosen if the team must consist of exactly 3 badminton players and 2 squash players.

questions.prompt: A research project committee of 4 members is to be chosen from a department of 10 scientists, which includes Dr Adams and Dr Brown.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different committees of 4 members that can be chosen if both Dr Adams and Dr Brown must be included.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of different committees of 4 members that can be chosen if Dr Adams must be included and Dr Brown cannot be included.

questions.prompt: Twelve expedition members are to be partitioned into separate travel groups.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of ways the 12 members can be divided into three distinct groups containing 5, 4, and 3 members respectively.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of ways the 12 members can be divided into four unlabelled groups of 3 members each.

questions.prompt: A drama troupe consists of 7 actors and 5 actresses. A performance cast of 6 performers is to be chosen.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different casts of 6 performers that contain at least 4 actors.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Two of the actors, James and Oliver, refuse to perform in the same cast together. Find the number of different casts of 6 performers that can be chosen from the 12 performers such that James and Oliver are not both included.

questions.prompt: Eight students attend a leadership retreat. The camp has two distinct dormitories: Dormitory A with 5 beds and Dormitory B with 3 beds. Two of the students are Sam and Leo.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of ways the 8 students can be assigned to the two dormitories if Sam and Leo must both be assigned to Dormitory A.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of ways the 8 students can be assigned to the two dormitories if Sam and Leo must be in different dormitories from each other.

questions.prompt: A debate society has 14 members, comprising 8 university students and 6 high school students. A team of 5 speakers is to be selected.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the total number of ways to select a team of 5 speakers from the 14 members if there are no restrictions.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of ways to select a team of 5 speakers that contains at least 3 university students and at least 1 high school student.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Among the 8 university students is Zara, and among the 6 high school students is Yasmin. Find the number of teams of 5 speakers that can be selected from the 14 members such that Zara and Yasmin cannot both be chosen.

questions.prompt: Ten musicians are to be divided into ensemble performance groups.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of ways the 10 musicians can be partitioned into two labelled ensembles, Ensemble X with 6 musicians and Ensemble Y with 4 musicians.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of ways the 10 musicians can be divided into two unlabelled quintets (groups of 5 musicians each).

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Two of the 10 musicians, Maya and Noah, refuse to be placed into the same unlabelled quintet. Find the number of ways the 10 musicians can be divided into two unlabelled quintets such that Maya and Noah are in different quintets.
